eyebrow: The Circuit: H, Then S, on |0>

steps.label: H = (1/sqrt2)[[1,1],[1,-1]]: unitary, Chapters 2 & 5
steps.sub: S = [[1,0],[0,i]]: complex entries, phase gate, Chapters 3 & 7

steps.label: |0> = [1,0]: basis vector, Chapter 1
steps.sub: Apply via matrix-vector multiplication, in order

eyebrow: Tracing the State, Step by Step
code:
after H: H.|0> = [0.7071, 0.7071]

after S: S.(after H) = [0.7071, 0.7071i]

probabilities = |amplitude|^2 = [0.5, 0.5]
caption: H produces a valid normalized state (0.7071^2+0.7071^2=1); S multiplies the second amplitude by i, rotating it 90 degrees on the unit circle.

steps.label: S changed the phase of the second amplitude, not its magnitude
steps.sub: Measurement probability depends only on magnitude — the phase is invisible here
